name: Linear Fine Woodworking
old_description: Linear Fine Woodworking provides beautiful custom-built cabinetry and architectural millwork to areas like Phoenix and Scottsdale Arizona as well as the greater Southwest. Each Linear Fine Woodworking creation is a work of art crafted and custom-built just for you. Whether it’s custom designed kitchen cabinetry, a wall unit, home theatre unit, or office furniture, innovation in design and woodworking is a hallmark of Linear Fine Woodworking products.
about:
Linear Fine Woodworking operates from Phoenix, Arizona, where it has been designing and building custom cabinetry, furniture, and architectural millwork for more than three decades. The company serves clients across Phoenix, Scottsdale, and the broader Southwest region.

The shop produces custom cabinetry, architectural millwork, and furniture for residential and commercial projects. A distinctive capability is the in-house production of veneer panels from rough-cut flitches, a process that yields uniformly stable panels and expands design possibilities. The team works with exotic veneers, solid woods, glass, lighting, cabling, and specialized hardware to create pieces that blend function with sculpture.

Projects range from kitchen cabinetry and wall units to home theater installations and office furniture. The company works directly with homeowners, designers, and contractors on both residential and commercial woodworking projects throughout the Southwest.

Linear Fine Woodworking emphasizes its combined team experience of over 350 years and its rare in-house veneer panel manufacturing as core differentiators. The firm was founded on the goal of merging custom furniture and cabinetry with fine art, a philosophy that continues to guide its approach.
